verdict.rationale: Appwrite Functions are the product's own background automation primitive: they run on server events, webhooks, and scheduled executions across 13+ runtimes, without a user present. Messaging also supports scheduled sends. Evidence is a few one-line doc claims, with no detail on scheduling syntax, execution limits, or monitoring. Missing for 10: detailed docs on cron/schedule configuration and async execution limits, logging or monitoring of background runs, any agent-driven autonomous workflow capability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
